name: 1454-batchdecode-llama70b-tp4
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct, served with FP8 linear weights produced at load time from the 16-bit checkpoint. The NousResearch re-upload is used because meta-llama/Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct is gated `manual`; same weights, ungated.
parallelism: TP=4, DP=1, PP=1. One node, no router, no external cache tier.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 80 layers, hidden 8192, 64 attention heads over 8 KV heads with head_dim 128, vocab 128256, 70.55 B parameters; the rest is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 2048 requests with a 3600 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix: 2048 prompt tokens in and 1024 output tokens out, both fixed, with `ignore_eos: true` and `temperature: 0.0`, so every request decodes 1024 steps.
purpose: A long-form drafting assistant on a 70-billion-parameter model, serving 256 concurrent users long prompts across four GPUs.
launch:
# sglang at commit aa2750beb30fe6663fa68162b8937399cebb03e4 (`git describe` =
# v0.3.1.post1-7-gaa2750beb30), four GPUs of one node, tensor parallel.

model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct
tp-size: 4

# FP8 linear weights, produced at load time from the 16-bit checkpoint. The KV cache is unaffected
# and stays bf16 (kv-cache-dtype is left at `auto`).
quantization: fp8

# MANDATORY at this commit: ReqToTokenPool is sized max_num_reqs x (context_len + 8) with
# max_num_reqs floored at 2048, so the checkpoint's declared 131072-token window cannot be
# allocated and the server will not start. 8192 covers the 3072 tokens this workload uses.
context-length: 8192

# This commit's own default at tp-size >= 4; written down because it is the knob the operating
# point is most sensitive to.
mem-fraction-static: 0.85

# Absent, this commit picks `random.randint(0, 1 << 30)` per launch.
random-seed: 42

# host / port / served-model-name are left to whatever starts the server. Everything else --
# attention backend, cuda graphs, chunked prefill, max-running-requests, radix cache,
# schedule-policy, dtype, kv-cache-dtype, torchao-config -- is stock for this commit.
